description: Debloat and optional services rules for Google Pixel smartphones running Pixel UI / stock Android.

rules.name: Pixel Ambient Services (Now Playing)
rules.description: Background lockscreen music identification and contextual song recognition. Disabling prevents continuous low-power DSP microphone polling.

rules.name: Pixel Tips
rules.description: Onboarding feature showcase app displaying tips and tricks after Pixel Feature Drops.

rules.name: Device Health Services
rules.description: Calculates personalized battery percentage estimates and adaptive screen brightness machine learning models.

rules.name: Google Feedback
rules.description: User feedback uploader and crash log dispatcher for Google Play Services and system apps.

rules.name: Sound Amplifier
rules.description: Headphone audio enhancement accessibility tool that amplifies quiet sounds and filters ambient noise.

rules.name: Pixel Live Wallpapers
rules.description: Animated live wallpaper backgrounds. Disabling frees up RAM and GPU rendering overhead.

rules.name: Cinematic Wallpaper Effects
rules.description: On-device 3D parallax depth effect generator for static home screen wallpapers.

rules.name: Google Wallpapers
rules.description: Wallpaper picker app with daily wallpaper downloads and curated photo collections.

rules.name: Google Partner Setup
rules.description: Carrier and OEM partner configuration tool used during initial device setup.

rules.name: Android Auto
rules.description: In-car infotainment display projection for navigation, calls, and audio. Safe to disable if you do not use your phone with a car dashboard.

rules.name: Google TV (Play Movies & TV)
rules.description: Movie rental store, streaming aggregator, and virtual remote app.

rules.name: Google News
rules.description: News headline feed and publication subscription reader.

rules.name: YouTube Music Stub
rules.description: System preload registration stub for YouTube Music streaming client.

rules.name: YouTube Music
rules.description: Official YouTube Music streaming app. Reinstallable from Google Play Store if desired.

rules.name: Digital Wellbeing
rules.description: Constantly logs app foreground usage, notification counts, and unlock frequencies. Disabling noticeably saves battery and CPU cycles.

rules.name: Google Wallet (Quick Access Wallet)
rules.description: NFC payment pass and loyalty card hub accessible from lockscreen and quick settings. Safe to disable if not using mobile contactless pay.

rules.name: Personal Safety
rules.description: Pixel car crash detection, safety check countdown, and emergency sharing. Keep enabled if relying on vehicle crash dispatch.

rules.name: Live Transcribe
rules.description: Real-time speech-to-text accessibility transcription service.

rules.name: Android Accessibility Suite (TalkBack)
rules.description: Screen reader for visually impaired users. Safe to disable if you do not use screen reader spoken feedback.

rules.name: Pixel Recorder
rules.description: Audio voice recorder with on-device speech transcription and speaker labeling.

rules.name: Files by Google
rules.description: Default Google file manager and junk cleaner. Reinstallable from Play Store.

rules.name: Google Fit
rules.description: Activity tracking and step counter application.

rules.name: Google Drive
rules.description: Google Drive cloud document viewer and backup client.

rules.name: Google Meet
rules.description: Video conferencing and calling app. Safe to remove if using WhatsApp, Telegram, or Zoom.

rules.name: Google Podcasts
rules.description: Deprecated podcast player application.
